raw_fields.name: Giustina et al. 2015 loophole-free photonic Bell experiment
raw_fields.statement: The 2015 Giustina et al. experiment used entangled photons, rapid setting choices and high-efficiency superconducting detectors to close the principal locality and detection loopholes simultaneously.

raw_fields.name: Giustina et al. 2015 loophole-free Bell-violation result
raw_fields.statement: Under the trial definition and local-realist null model of Giustina et al., the photonic dataset violated the selected Bell inequality with reported purely statistical probability no greater than 3.74 x 10^-31, corresponding to 11.5 standard deviations.

raw_fields.name: Hensen et al. 2015 event-ready loophole-free Bell experiment
raw_fields.statement: The 2015 Delft event-ready Bell experiment used heralded entanglement of electron spins separated by 1.3 km with spacelike-separated setting and readout operations.

raw_fields.name: Hensen et al. 2015 loophole-free Bell-violation result
raw_fields.statement: Under the event-ready trial definition and local-realist null model of Hensen et al., the reported 245-trial dataset gave CHSH S = 2.42 +/- 0.20 and rejected that null with p <= 0.039 without fair-sampling or locality loopholes.

raw_fields.name: Shalm et al. 2015 loophole-free photonic Bell experiment
raw_fields.statement: The 2015 Shalm et al. experiment used entangled photon pairs, fast random settings, spacelike-separated relevant events and high-efficiency low-noise detectors without a fair-sampling assumption.

raw_fields.name: Shalm et al. 2015 loophole-free Bell-violation result
raw_fields.statement: Under the Shalm et al. local-realism hypothesis test, the photonic dataset produced p-values as small as 5.9 x 10^-9 and an adjusted minimum p-value 2.3 x 10^-7 after accounting for estimated predictability of measurement choices.

raw_fields.name: Hawking black-hole rigidity theorem in the analytic nondegenerate stationary rotating case
raw_fields.statement: A four-dimensional analytic asymptotically flat stationary rotating vacuum black-hole spacetime with a regular connected nondegenerate event horizon and the standard global hypotheses admits an axial Killing field commuting with the stationary Killing field, and the horizon generator is their constant angular-velocity combination.

raw_fields.name: Jebsen-Birkhoff theorem in four-dimensional vacuum general relativity
raw_fields.statement: Every C2 four-dimensional spherically symmetric Lorentzian solution of the vacuum Einstein equations with zero cosmological constant is locally a Schwarzschild solution and admits the corresponding additional hypersurface-orthogonal Killing symmetry.

raw_fields.name: Buckingham Pi theorem
raw_fields.statement: If a dimensionally homogeneous relation among n nonzero dimensional quantities is invariant under r independent base-unit rescalings and the dimension matrix has rank r, the relation can be expressed in terms of n-r independent dimensionless monomials spanning the kernel of that matrix.

raw_fields.name: Coleman-Mandula theorem
raw_fields.statement: For a nontrivial analytic relativistic S-matrix in 3+1 dimensions satisfying the Coleman-Mandula assumptions, every connected ordinary bosonic Lie symmetry of the S-matrix is locally a direct product of the Poincare group and an internal symmetry group.

raw_fields.name: EHT 2017 M87 calibrated visibility data products
raw_fields.statement: The calibrated 1.3 mm very-long-baseline-interferometry data-product family derived from the Event Horizon Telescope's four 2017 observing days targeting M87*, together with the release's calibration and processing lineage.

raw_fields.name: EHT 2017 M87* asymmetric-ring observation
raw_fields.statement: Across four 2017 EHT M87* observing days and multiple calibration/imaging schemes, the compact 1.3 mm source was resolved as an asymmetric bright ring of angular diameter 42 +/- 3 microarcseconds surrounding a central brightness depression with flux contrast at least 10:1.

raw_fields.name: EHT 2017 Sagittarius A* calibrated visibility and multiwavelength data products
raw_fields.statement: The calibrated 1.3 mm EHT VLBI and coordinated multiwavelength data-product family from the 2017 Sagittarius A* campaign, with the collaboration's processing and calibration lineage.

raw_fields.name: EHT 2017 Sagittarius A* thick-ring observation
raw_fields.statement: The 2017 EHT Sagittarius A* data resolve an intrahour-variable compact source whose diverse imaging/modeling analyses support a bright thick ring of diameter 51.8 +/- 2.3 microarcseconds at 68% credible interval with modest azimuthal asymmetry and a dimmer interior.

raw_fields.name: Elitzur's theorem for lattice gauge theories
raw_fields.statement: In a lattice gauge theory with compact local gauge group, gauge-invariant local action and measure, and neither gauge fixing nor an explicit symmetry-breaking source, every local observable whose Haar average under a gauge transformation at one site vanishes has zero expectation value.

raw_fields.name: Friedel phase-shift sum rule for a localized scatterer
raw_fields.statement: At zero temperature, for a noninteracting Fermi gas perturbed by a localized sufficiently short-range one-body potential, the impurity-induced excess number of occupied states below the Fermi energy equals the sum of scattering phase shifts at the Fermi energy divided by pi, with channel degeneracies and bound-state jumps included by the fixed continuous phase convention.

raw_fields.name: Goldstone theorem for spontaneously broken continuous global symmetry
raw_fields.statement: In a local relativistic quantum field theory with an exact continuous global internal symmetry, conserved current, Poincare-invariant vacuum and the usual locality and spectrum assumptions, a nonzero vacuum expectation of the commutator of the charge with a local field forces zero-mass support in the current-field spectral function.

raw_fields.name: GWTC-5.0 candidate and parameter-estimation data release, stable release 9
raw_fields.statement: Versioned GWOSC/Zenodo data product for the GWTC-5.0 cumulative gravitational-wave transient catalog through observing run O4b, including event-level search results, strain links and stable-release-9 parameter-estimation products where supplied.

raw_fields.name: GWTC-5.0 catalog-selection content claim
raw_fields.statement: The documented GWTC-5.0 event release contains gravitational-wave transient candidates through O4b that pass P_astro > 0.5, and it triggers parameter-estimation results for candidates with false-alarm rate below one per year, using the release's named search pipelines and posterior products.

raw_fields.name: Haag's theorem in scalar Wightman-field form
raw_fields.statement: If a free scalar Wightman field and another scalar field satisfying the corresponding covariance, spectrum, unique-vacuum and irreducibility assumptions are related by a time-independent unitary that implements the required equal-time interaction-picture equivalence, then the second field has the free two-point function and is itself free.

raw_fields.name: Hawking area theorem for classical future event horizons
raw_fields.statement: For a sufficiently regular classical future event horizon satisfying the required predictability or future-completeness hypotheses and the null convergence condition, the area of later compact spacelike horizon cross-sections is not smaller than the area of earlier ones.

raw_fields.name: Planck-2018 versus SH0ES-2022 Hubble-constant discrepancy
raw_fields.statement: The Planck 2018 base-Lambda-CDM inference H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 and the SH0ES 2022 local distance-ladder result H0 = 73.04 +/- 1.04 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 differ by about five combined standard deviations under the uncertainty models reported by those analyses.

raw_fields.name: Kallen-Lehmann spectral representation
raw_fields.statement: In a positive-metric relativistic QFT satisfying Poincare covariance, vacuum uniqueness and the spectrum condition, the vacuum two-point distribution of a scalar field is a positive spectral superposition of free two-point functions.

raw_fields.name: Kochen-Specker theorem
raw_fields.statement: On a real or complex Hilbert space of dimension at least three, no noncontextual deterministic 0/1 valuation of every rank-one projector can assign exactly one value 1 to each complete orthonormal-basis projector family.

raw_fields.name: Kohn theorem for cyclotron resonance
raw_fields.statement: For interacting particles with the same charge-to-mass ratio, quadratic continuum dispersion and translation-invariant interactions depending only on relative coordinates in a uniform magnetic field, center-of-mass cyclotron motion decouples and its resonance frequency is the bare cyclotron frequency independent of the interactions.

raw_fields.name: Kramers degeneracy theorem
raw_fields.statement: If a self-adjoint Hamiltonian commutes with a domain-preserving antiunitary time-reversal operator whose square is minus the identity, each eigenvector has an orthogonal partner at the same eigenvalue and every finite-multiplicity eigenvalue has even multiplicity.

raw_fields.name: Kibble-Zurek mechanism
raw_fields.statement: A framework relating critical slowing down during a finite-rate passage through a continuous transition to a freeze-out length/time and the formation of domains or topological defects.

raw_fields.name: Kibble-Zurek freeze-out scaling for a linear quench
raw_fields.statement: For a linear quench epsilon(t)=t/tau_Q through a continuous critical point with equilibrium xi=xi0|epsilon|^-nu and relaxation time tau=tau0|epsilon|^-znu, the adiabatic-impulse matching condition yields freeze-out time proportional to tau_Q^(z nu/(1+z nu)) and length proportional to tau_Q^(nu/(1+z nu)); independent-domain defect estimates inherit the corresponding inverse-length power.

raw_fields.name: Levinson theorem for three-dimensional short-range central-potential scattering
raw_fields.statement: For three-dimensional nonrelativistic scattering by a real regular sufficiently short-range central potential with no zero-energy half-bound state, the change of the l-th partial-wave phase shift from zero to infinite energy is pi times the number of bound states in that angular-momentum channel.

raw_fields.name: Lieb-Robinson bound
raw_fields.statement: For a quantum spin system on a metric graph with finite-dimensional local spaces and a sufficiently rapidly decaying interaction, commutators of initially separated local observables are exponentially small outside an effective linear light cone.

raw_fields.name: Luttinger Fermi-volume theorem
raw_fields.statement: At zero temperature in a translationally invariant particle-number-conserving normal Fermi liquid without translation breaking or topological order, the total oriented Fermi-sea volume, with all spin/flavor degeneracies counted, equals the filling modulo filled bands.

raw_fields.name: Muon anomalous magnetic moment: 2025 experiment-versus-Standard-Model status
raw_fields.statement: Using the 2025 E989-dominated world average a_mu(exp) = 116592071.5(14.5) x 10^-11 and the WP25 consolidated Standard-Model prediction a_mu(SM) = 116592033(62) x 10^-11, the difference is 38(63) x 10^-11 and is not statistically significant at the quoted precision.

raw_fields.name: Normal neutrino mass-ordering hypothesis
raw_fields.statement: For the three active-neutrino mass eigenstates labelled by the solar pair, the atmospheric splitting has normal ordering: m1 < m2 < m3, equivalently Delta m^2_31 is positive under the frozen convention.

raw_fields.name: Nielsen-Ninomiya fermion-doubling theorem
raw_fields.statement: For a Hermitian, translation-invariant and local lattice-fermion/Bloch Hamiltonian satisfying the theorem's regularity and exact chiral assumptions on the compact Brillouin torus, the total chirality of isolated Weyl zeros is zero.

raw_fields.name: Quantum no-broadcasting theorem
raw_fields.statement: A finite-dimensional family of density operators can be broadcast by one quantum channel exactly when all members of the family commute.

raw_fields.name: Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction theorem
raw_fields.statement: A scalar/bosonic family of Euclidean n-point tempered distributions satisfying the corrected Osterwalder-Schrader regularity/growth, Euclidean covariance, permutation symmetry and reflection-positivity axioms reconstructs a positive-energy Wightman quantum field theory whose Euclidean continuation gives the supplied distributions.

raw_fields.name: Quantum adiabatic theorem for a uniformly gapped finite-dimensional spectral band
raw_fields.statement: For a C2 finite-dimensional Hamiltonian path with a nonempty spectral band separated uniformly from the rest of the spectrum, evolution over total run time T transports the initial band projection to the instantaneous band projection with operator-norm error O(1/T).

raw_fields.name: Reeh-Schlieder theorem
raw_fields.statement: In the vacuum sector of a Minkowski Wightman quantum field theory, applying fields smeared inside any nonempty open spacetime region to the vacuum generates a dense subspace.

raw_fields.name: Topological censorship theorem
raw_fields.statement: In an asymptotically flat globally hyperbolic spacetime satisfying the averaged null energy condition and the corrected causal hypotheses, every causal curve from past null infinity to future null infinity can be fixed-endpoint deformed to a curve in a simply connected neighborhood of infinity.

raw_fields.name: Wigner-Araki-Yanase theorem
raw_fields.statement: For an exact measurement of a discrete-spectrum system observable under an additive conservation law, repeatability or the Yanase pointer condition forces the measured observable to commute with the conserved system part.

raw_fields.name: Wigner-Eckart theorem in SU(2) form
raw_fields.statement: For an irreducible SU(2) spherical tensor operator, every angular-momentum-basis matrix element factors into a Clebsch-Gordan coefficient and a reduced matrix element independent of magnetic quantum numbers.

raw_fields.name: Wigner theorem on quantum symmetries
raw_fields.statement: Every bijection of the rays of a complex Hilbert space of dimension at least two that preserves transition probabilities is induced by a unitary or antiunitary surjection, unique up to a global phase on rays.

raw_fields.name: Abstract-interpretation fixpoint soundness
raw_fields.statement: Let C and A be complete lattices with abstraction and concretization alpha left adjoint to gamma. If monotone F and F-sharp satisfy F composed with gamma <= gamma composed with F-sharp, then every abstract post-fixpoint a with F-sharp(a)<=a safely over-approximates the least concrete fixpoint: lfp(F)<=gamma(a).

raw_fields.name: Agnostic PAC learnability and finite VC dimension equivalence
raw_fields.statement: Under the standard measurability conditions and zero-one loss, a binary hypothesis class is distribution-free agnostically PAC learnable if and only if it has finite VC dimension.

raw_fields.name: Algebrization barrier
raw_fields.statement: Under the algebraic-oracle definitions in Aaronson and Wigderson, the exhibited oracle and algebraic-extension counterworlds show that an algebrizing proof cannot resolve P versus NP.

raw_fields.name: AMS second-frequency-moment streaming theorem
raw_fields.statement: In the one-pass turnstile stream model, the AMS sketch returns a (1 plus or minus epsilon) approximation to F2 with probability at least 1-delta using O(epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)) signed counters plus their logarithmic-bit seeds and storage.

raw_fields.name: APSP conjecture
raw_fields.statement: For every positive epsilon, exact all-pairs shortest paths on n-vertex directed graphs with O(log n)-bit integer edge weights has no O(n^(3-epsilon)) word-RAM algorithm.

raw_fields.name: Baker-Gill-Solovay relativization theorem
raw_fields.statement: There are oracles A and B for which P^A equals NP^A while P^B does not equal NP^B.

raw_fields.name: BLR linearity-testing theorem
raw_fields.statement: For oracle f from F_2^n to F_2, if the BLR check f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y) accepts with probability at least 1-epsilon for uniform independent x,y, then f is epsilon-close, under uniform Hamming distance, to a linear function; linear functions are always accepted.

raw_fields.name: Blum speedup theorem
raw_fields.statement: For every admissible total recursive speedup function in a fixed Blum complexity measure, there is a total recursive function for which every program has another program computing the same function with the prescribed eventual speedup.

raw_fields.name: Busy Beaver domination and noncomputability theorem
raw_fields.statement: For the fixed n-state Turing-machine convention, the Busy Beaver step function is not computable and eventually dominates every total computable numerical function after the fixed encoding overhead.

raw_fields.name: Computational Diffie-Hellman assumption
raw_fields.statement: For the fixed security-parameter-indexed cyclic-group generator, no probabilistic polynomial-time adversary given (g, g^a, g^b) outputs g^(ab) with non-negligible probability over uniform exponents and group generation.

raw_fields.name: Finite-candidate CEGIS termination and completeness
raw_fields.statement: For a finite SyGuS candidate language, a fair no-repeat CEGIS loop using a sound and complete verifier terminates with a satisfying candidate if one exists and otherwise terminates after exhausting all candidates.

raw_fields.name: Codd relational completeness theorem
raw_fields.statement: Over finite relational instances and under the fixed safety and active-domain convention, relational algebra and safe domain-independent relational calculus express the same queries.

raw_fields.name: CompCert compiler behavior refinement
raw_fields.statement: For a source program accepted and compiled by the CompCert version described in the primary paper, under its source and target semantics and defined-behavior precondition, every observable behavior of the generated target program is permitted by the source program.

raw_fields.name: Conflict-serializability graph criterion
raw_fields.statement: A finite single-version read-write schedule is conflict-serializable if and only if its precedence graph is acyclic; every topological ordering of that graph gives a conflict-equivalent serial schedule.

raw_fields.name: C++ data-race-free sequential-consistency guarantee
raw_fields.statement: In the cited C++ concurrency model, a program whose relevant executions are data-race-free under the model's synchronization discipline receives the model's sequential-consistency guarantee for those executions.

raw_fields.name: Decisional Diffie-Hellman assumption
raw_fields.statement: For the fixed security-parameter-indexed cyclic-group generator, no probabilistic polynomial-time adversary distinguishes (g,g^a,g^b,g^(ab)) from (g,g^a,g^b,g^c) with non-negligible advantage for uniform a,b,c.

raw_fields.name: Decision Learning With Errors assumption
raw_fields.statement: For the fixed functions n(lambda), q(lambda), sample count, and error distribution chi, no probabilistic polynomial-time distinguisher has non-negligible advantage between LWE samples (a,<a,s>+e mod q) and uniform samples in Z_q^n x Z_q.

raw_fields.name: Deterministic communication log-rank lower bound
raw_fields.statement: For every total Boolean two-party function f, deterministic communication complexity D(f) is at least log base two of the real rank of its communication matrix M_f.

raw_fields.name: Existence of a DistNP-complete distributional problem
raw_fields.statement: Under Levin's distributional-NP definitions and average-case reductions, there exists a distributional problem complete for DistNP.

raw_fields.name: Exponential Time Hypothesis
raw_fields.statement: There is a constant c greater than zero such that 3-SAT on n variables cannot be decided in deterministic time 2^(c n) times a polynomial in the input length.

raw_fields.name: Goldreich-Goldwasser-Micali PRF construction
raw_fields.statement: If G is a secure length-doubling pseudorandom generator with halves G0 and G1, then the keyed binary-tree family F_s(x_1...x_n)=G_(x_n)(...G_(x_1)(s)) is a pseudorandom function family against probabilistic polynomial-time oracle distinguishers.

raw_fields.name: Cook relative completeness of Hoare logic
raw_fields.statement: For the specified while language and interpretation I, if the assertion language is expressive for the required strongest postconditions, every semantically valid partial-correctness triple is derivable from Hoare rules together with all true assertions of I.

raw_fields.name: Impagliazzo-Rudich black-box barrier
raw_fields.statement: In the oracle and black-box-reduction model of Impagliazzo and Rudich, there is an oracle world with one-way permutations but without secure key agreement, ruling out a relativizing black-box implication of key agreement from one-way permutations.

raw_fields.name: L versus NL
raw_fields.statement: Does deterministic logarithmic space equal nondeterministic logarithmic space?

raw_fields.name: MIP* = RE
raw_fields.statement: The class of languages with multiprover interactive proofs whose provers may share entanglement equals the class of recursively enumerable languages.

raw_fields.name: NP versus coNP
raw_fields.statement: Does nondeterministic polynomial time equal its complement class?

raw_fields.name: Orthogonal Vectors Conjecture
raw_fields.statement: For every positive epsilon there is a constant c such that deciding whether n Boolean vectors in dimension d=c log n contain an orthogonal pair has no O(n^(2-epsilon)) word-RAM algorithm.

raw_fields.name: One-way functions imply P does not equal NP
raw_fields.statement: If a length-regular polynomial-time computable one-way function exists against the fixed probabilistic polynomial-time inversion model, then P does not equal NP.

raw_fields.name: P not equal to NP implies one-way functions
raw_fields.statement: If P does not equal NP, then a length-regular polynomial-time computable one-way function exists against the fixed uniform probabilistic polynomial-time inversion model.

raw_fields.name: Parameterized Clique is W[1]-complete
raw_fields.statement: The parameterized problem that asks whether a graph contains a clique of size k, parameterized by k, is complete for W[1] under fixed-parameter tractable many-one reductions.

raw_fields.name: Realizable PAC learnability and finite VC dimension equivalence
raw_fields.statement: Under the standard measurability conditions, a binary concept class is distribution-free PAC learnable in the realizable case if and only if it has finite VC dimension.

raw_fields.name: Sauer-Shelah lemma
raw_fields.statement: If a family F of subsets of an n-element set has VC dimension d, then |F| is at most the sum from i=0 through d of binomial(n,i).

raw_fields.name: Search Learning With Errors assumption
raw_fields.statement: For the fixed functions n(lambda), q(lambda), sample count, and error distribution chi, no probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm recovers uniform secret s from polynomially many samples (a, <a,s>+e mod q) with non-negligible probability.

raw_fields.name: Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis
raw_fields.statement: For every positive epsilon there exists k such that k-SAT on n variables has no deterministic O((2-epsilon)^n poly(n)) algorithm.

raw_fields.name: Short Integer Solution assumption
raw_fields.statement: For uniform A in Z_q^(n by m) and the frozen parameter functions, no probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm finds a nonzero integer vector z with A z = 0 modulo q and norm at most beta with non-negligible probability.

raw_fields.name: 3SUM conjecture
raw_fields.statement: For every positive epsilon, deciding whether n real inputs contain three distinct indexed elements whose sum is zero has no O(n^(2-epsilon)) real-RAM algorithm.

raw_fields.name: Two-phase locking implies conflict serializability
raw_fields.statement: Every schedule generated by well-formed transactions obeying two-phase locking is conflict-serializable.

raw_fields.name: Universal Composition theorem
raw_fields.statement: If protocol rho UC-emulates ideal functionality F and protocol pi UC-realizes G in the F-hybrid model, then the protocol obtained by replacing each F call in pi by rho UC-emulates G.

raw_fields.name: Weighted Majority mistake bound
raw_fields.statement: For N binary experts, Weighted Majority with penalty beta in (0,1) makes at most [ln(1/beta)/ln(2/(1+beta))] times the mistakes of any fixed expert plus ln(N)/ln(2/(1+beta)) mistakes.

raw_fields.name: Structure theorem for finitely generated abelian groups
raw_fields.statement: 每个有限生成阿贝尔群唯一分解为自由部分与满足整除链的有限循环群直和。

raw_fields.name: Jacobian conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 特征零域上的多项式自映射若雅可比行列式为非零常数，则存在多项式逆映射。

raw_fields.name: Krull–Schmidt theorem
raw_fields.statement: 有限长度模可分解为有限个不可分解模的直和，且该分解在置换与同构意义下唯一。

raw_fields.name: GAGA coherent-sheaf equivalence
raw_fields.statement: 复数域上的射影概形的相干代数层与其解析化上的相干解析层由解析化函子给出等价。

raw_fields.name: Serre duality
raw_fields.statement: 光滑射影 n 维簇上向量丛的第 i 上同调与其对偶扭正则层的第 n−i 上同调互为线性对偶。

raw_fields.name: Tate conjecture over finite fields
raw_fields.statement: 有限域上光滑射影簇的每个 Galois 不变偶次 ℓ 进上同调类都由有理系数代数循环给出。

raw_fields.name: Fundamental theorem of calculus, differentiation part
raw_fields.statement: 连续函数从固定端点到变量端点的积分是该函数的一个原函数。

raw_fields.name: Fundamental theorem of calculus, evaluation part
raw_fields.statement: 连续函数的定积分等于任一原函数在两端点取值之差。

raw_fields.name: Implicit function theorem
raw_fields.statement: 若方程 F(x,y)=0 对 y 的偏导在解点可逆，则解集局部唯一地是 C¹ 图 y=g(x)。

raw_fields.name: Inverse function theorem
raw_fields.statement: C¹ 映射在导数可逆的点附近是 C¹ 微分同胚。

raw_fields.name: Lebesgue differentiation theorem
raw_fields.statement: 局部可积函数在几乎处处的点等于其缩小球平均值的极限。

raw_fields.name: Hadamard matrix conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 每个正整数 n 都存在 4n 阶阿达马矩阵。

raw_fields.name: Lonely runner conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 对 n 个相对静止观察者具有互异非零整数速度的跑者，存在时刻使每位跑者到整数圈点的距离至少为 1/(n+1)。

raw_fields.name: Union-closed sets conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 每个有限、并封闭且底集非空的集族中，至少有一个元素属于不少于一半的成员。

raw_fields.name: Lefschetz standard conjecture B
raw_fields.statement: 光滑射影簇的硬莱夫谢茨同构之逆由代数对应诱导。

raw_fields.name: Künneth standard conjecture C
raw_fields.statement: 光滑射影簇对角类的每个上同调凯尼希投影分量都是代数循环类。

raw_fields.name: Standard conjecture D (homological equals numerical equivalence)
raw_fields.statement: 光滑射影簇上有理系数代数循环的同调等价关系与数值等价关系相同。

raw_fields.name: Hodge-type standard conjecture I
raw_fields.statement: 适当符号修正的莱夫谢茨交叉形式在本原代数循环的数值等价类上正定。

raw_fields.name: Bombieri–Lang conjecture (weak form)
raw_fields.statement: 数域上的一般型射影簇的有理点在 Zariski 拓扑中不稠密。

raw_fields.name: Banach–Alaoglu theorem
raw_fields.statement: 赋范空间对偶的闭单位球在弱星拓扑下是紧的。

raw_fields.name: Class equation of a finite group
raw_fields.statement: 有限群的阶等于中心的阶加上各非中心共轭类大小之和。

raw_fields.name: First isomorphism theorem for groups
raw_fields.statement: 群同态的定义域模其核同构于其像。

raw_fields.name: Orbit–stabilizer theorem
raw_fields.statement: 群作用中一点的轨道与其稳定子的左陪集集合自然双射；有限情形轨道大小等于稳定子指数。

raw_fields.name: Second isomorphism theorem for groups
raw_fields.statement: 若 H 是 G 的子群、N 是 G 的正规子群，则 H/(H∩N) 同构于 HN/N。

raw_fields.name: Third isomorphism theorem for groups
raw_fields.statement: 若 N 包含于 H 且二者都是 G 的正规子群，则 (G/N)/(H/N) 同构于 G/H。

raw_fields.name: Carathéodory extension theorem
raw_fields.statement: 代数上的 σ-有限预测度唯一扩张为其生成 σ-代数上的测度。

raw_fields.name: Analytic class number formula
raw_fields.statement: 数域 K 的戴德金 ζ 函数在 s=1 的留数由类数、调节子、单位根数和判别式给出。

raw_fields.name: Bateman–Horn conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 满足不可约性和无局部阻碍的整系数多项式组同时取素数值的次数服从带 Euler 乘积常数的预测渐近式。

raw_fields.name: Collatz conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 从任意正整数出发，偶数除以 2、奇数变为 3n+1 的反复迭代最终到达 1。

raw_fields.name: Erdős–Straus conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 每个 n≥2 的 4/n 都能表示成三个正单位分数之和。

raw_fields.name: Fontaine–Mazur conjecture (geometric representation form)
raw_fields.statement: 不可约且仅在有限多素数处分歧、在 p 处潜在半稳定的 p 进伽罗瓦表示都来自代数簇的 étale 上同调。

raw_fields.name: Lagrange's four-square theorem
raw_fields.statement: 每个非负整数都是四个整数平方之和。

raw_fields.name: Lehmer's conjecture (Mahler-measure gap)
raw_fields.statement: 整系数首一多项式的马勒测度在 1 以上存在统一正间隙，除非该多项式由 x 与分圆多项式相乘得到。

raw_fields.name: Hadwiger–Nelson problem
raw_fields.statement: 确定欧氏平面的单位距离图的色数：至少需要多少种颜色才能使距离恰为 1 的两点异色？

raw_fields.name: Hilbert's sixteenth problem, second part
raw_fields.statement: 对每个次数 d，求平面 d 次多项式向量场孤立极限环数目的统一上界并分类其相对位置。

raw_fields.name: Hilbert's sixteenth problem, first part
raw_fields.statement: 对每个次数 d，分类非奇异实射影平面代数曲线实点集各连通分支的可能数目与相对位置。

raw_fields.name: Inverse Galois problem over Q
raw_fields.statement: 每个有限群是否都能实现为某个有理数域有限伽罗瓦扩张的伽罗瓦群？

raw_fields.name: Gelfand–Naimark representation theorem
raw_fields.statement: 每个 C* 代数都有一个到某个希尔伯特空间上有界算子代数的忠实等距 *-表示。

raw_fields.name: Commutative Gelfand representation theorem
raw_fields.statement: 每个含幺交换 C* 代数经盖尔范德变换等距 *-同构于其特征空间上的连续函数代数。

raw_fields.name: Glivenko–Cantelli theorem
raw_fields.statement: 实值独立同分布样本的经验分布函数几乎必然一致收敛到真实分布函数。

raw_fields.name: Kolmogorov extension theorem
raw_fields.statement: 标准 Borel 状态空间上的相容有限维分布族唯一确定乘积柱 σ-代数上的概率测度。

raw_fields.name: Cramér–Rao bound
raw_fields.statement: 在正则单参数模型中，g(θ) 的任意无偏估计量的方差至少为 (g′(θ))²/I(θ)。

raw_fields.name: Fisher–Neyman factorization theorem
raw_fields.statement: 在可数参数的受控统计模型中，统计量 T 充分当且仅当各密度可分解为只经 T 依赖样本的参数项与参数无关项之积。

raw_fields.name: Gauss–Markov theorem
raw_fields.statement: 在满列秩、同方差且误差不相关的线性模型中，普通最小二乘是协方差意义下最佳的线性无偏估计量。

raw_fields.name: Lehmann–Scheffé theorem
raw_fields.statement: 完备充分统计量的任意平方可积无偏函数是目标参数的唯一一致最小方差无偏估计量。

raw_fields.name: Neyman–Pearson lemma
raw_fields.statement: 检验两个简单假设时，在给定显著性水平内，似然比阈值检验是最强力检验。

raw_fields.name: Rao–Blackwell theorem
raw_fields.statement: 对充分统计量取条件期望，在凸损失下不会增加估计风险。

raw_fields.name: Borsuk–Ulam theorem
raw_fields.statement: 每个连续映射 f:S^n→R^n 都在一对对跖点取相同值。

raw_fields.name: Hairy-ball theorem
raw_fields.statement: 每个偶维球面上的连续切向量场至少有一个零点。

raw_fields.name: Invariance of domain
raw_fields.statement: 欧氏 n 维空间开集到同维欧氏空间的连续单射是开映射，并且是到其像的同胚。

raw_fields.name: Jordan curve theorem
raw_fields.statement: 平面中的每条简单闭曲线把平面恰分成两个连通分支，并且曲线是两者的共同边界。

raw_fields.name: Jordan–Schoenflies theorem
raw_fields.statement: 平面中的任意简单闭曲线嵌入都可扩张为整个平面的自同胚。

raw_fields.name: Schanuel's conjecture
raw_fields.statement: 若 n 个复数在 Q 上线性无关，则这些数及其指数共同生成的域在 Q 上的超越次数至少为 n。

raw_fields.name: Computational Diffie-Hellman assumption — AT-S4-CGP1 profile
raw_fields.statement: In the explicit AT-S4-CGP1 prime-order group ensemble, the probability that any uniform probabilistic polynomial-time adversary given (1^lambda,p_lambda,q_lambda,g_lambda,g_lambda^a,g_lambda^b) outputs g_lambda^(ab) is negligible in lambda.

raw_fields.name: Decisional Diffie-Hellman assumption — AT-S4-CGP1 profile
raw_fields.statement: In the explicit AT-S4-CGP1 prime-order group ensemble, every uniform probabilistic polynomial-time adversary has negligible distinguishing advantage between (g_lambda^a,g_lambda^b,g_lambda^(ab)) and (g_lambda^a,g_lambda^b,g_lambda^c).

raw_fields.name: Decision-LWE assumption — AT-S4-LP1 profile
raw_fields.statement: For the explicit AT-S4-LP1 parameter profile, every uniform probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm has negligible advantage in distinguishing m(lambda) LWE samples sharing one uniform secret from m(lambda) independent uniform pairs.

raw_fields.name: Search-LWE assumption — AT-S4-LP1 profile
raw_fields.statement: For the explicit AT-S4-LP1 parameter profile, no uniform probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm recovers the uniform secret from the m(lambda) Search-LWE samples with non-negligible probability.

raw_fields.name: Short Integer Solution assumption — AT-S4-LP1 profile
raw_fields.statement: For the explicit AT-S4-LP1 parameter profile, no uniform probabilistic polynomial-time algorithm given uniform A in Z_q^(n by m) finds a nonzero integer vector z with A z=0 modulo q and Euclidean norm at most beta(lambda) with non-negligible probability.

raw_fields.name: Modularity theorem for elliptic curves over Q (exact variant)
raw_fields.statement: 每条定义在有理数域上的椭圆曲线都对应一个权 2、级别等于其导子的归一化新形式。

raw_fields.name: Thue–Siegel–Roth theorem (exact approximation variant)
raw_fields.statement: 对任意无理代数数 α 与任意 ε>0，不等式 |α−p/q|<q^(−2−ε) 只有有限多个既约有理解。

raw_fields.name: Blum speedup theorem — exact almost-everywhere form
raw_fields.statement: For every Blum complexity measure (phi,Phi) and every total computable two-argument speedup function r, there is a total computable predicate g such that every index i computing g has another index j computing g with r(x,Phi_j(x)) at most Phi_i(x) for all but finitely many x.

raw_fields.name: Rado step Busy Beaver S(n) domination theorem — exact convention
raw_fields.statement: Under Rado's n-state, two-symbol, blank-tape convention, the maximum halting step count S(n) is noncomputable and eventually exceeds every total computable numerical function.

raw_fields.name: Rao–Blackwell theorem for R^d-valued estimators — exact convex-loss form
raw_fields.statement: 在标准 Borel 统计模型中，用充分统计量的参数无关条件核对 R^d 值可积估计量取条件均值，在非负有限凸损失下不增加风险。
